scope: Bounded static review of active Rebase/Cherry Pick message recovery; not a full Rebase parity audit.

source.behavior: Skip returns before the empty-subject warning; skipped rows must remain skipped.
For a retained row with GetSubject().IsEmpty(), display IDS_PROC_REBASE_EMPTYCOMMITMSG and change the local execution mode to Edit. This does not assign a new action to the stored list row.
Successful Edit execution enters the Edit stage and stops replay for user review.

native.behavior: rebaseTodo serializes the selected action and sanitized subject without an empty-subject execution-mode override.
Actual replay todo similarly preserves selected actions. The default GIT_EDITOR is /usr/bin/true; the separate message editor is configured for Squash, not empty-subject Pick.
Structural replay uses the requested action and only emits a merge Edit break for an explicitly selected Edit; it has no empty-subject review override.

gap.current: No equivalent empty-subject warning and forced Edit review transition exists in the inspected native execution paths. A retained Pick is submitted to Git as Pick.
gap.required: Preserve source Skip behavior, warn for retained empty-subject rows, and route execution into the existing owned Edit/message recovery workflow rather than relying on Git's version-specific empty-message behavior.
proposed_connected_scope: Ordinary Rebase, Cherry Pick and structural replay execution-mode handling with occurrence identity retained
Source warning plus editable message, Continue/Split/Abort and author metadata through the existing stopped-session workflow
Squash-neighbor and explicit action interactions traced against source ordering before implementation
Cancellation, retired owner and changed-session refusal for any delayed warning answer

related_behavior_already_implemented: Preserve-merges Add is deliberately disabled by source RebaseDlg.cpp:1850 and native RebaseWindow.swift:1347; it is not a missing Add workflow.
Source RebaseDlg.cpp:2195-2201 rejects squashing a merge commit; native Rebase.swift:754 retains this restriction.
Existing native failed-pick Retry/Skip recovery is present at RebaseWindow.swift:2318 onward; it does not supply the missing empty-subject warning/Edit transition.
Existing Rebase bulk actions, ordering, F5, Split and message-recovery controls must be reused rather than counted as absent foundations.
limitations: No production changes, builds, tests, Git mutations or GUI actions were performed for this audit.
Actual behavior of a specific Git version when replaying an empty-message commit was not executed; the confirmed divergence is the missing explicit source warning and execution-mode transition.
This record identifies a bounded implementation gap, not several independent missing Rebase features or complete source/visual/signed certification.

subsequent_implementation.note: The original source audit and its unimplemented-at-review status above are historical. The later connected batch implements this policy and records focused Core/native validation, failures, repairs and remaining acceptance boundaries.
